news.headline: PB Fintech shares can rally 91% after 2-day bloodbath, says Bernstein. Here’s why it remains bullish
news.summary: PB Fintech shares rose 4% after Bernstein retained its Outperform rating and Rs 2,310 target price, despite the stock’s sharp fall following IRDAI’s proposed ban on dark patterns. The brokerage expects lower insurance take rates, revenue and profit estimates, while cost rationalisation could provide some cushion. IRDAI’s draft framework also proposes sweeping changes to insurance distribution and commission structures.

news.headline: Japanese bond yields climb towards multi-decade highs on inflation, BOJ tightening bets
news.summary: Japanese government bond yields climbed on Monday as rising services inflation and Bank of Japan rate-hike expectations weighed on debt prices. The benchmark 10-year yield approached multi-decade highs near 3.095%, while investors monitored upcoming Ministry of Finance bond auction plans and central bank policy minutes.

news.headline: Orient Cables IPO Day 2: GMP signals 33% listing premium; check subscription and key details
news.summary: Orient Cables IPO entered Day 2 of bidding with a 33% listing premium signal in the grey market. The Rs 552 crore issue was subscribed 1.96 times overall on Day 1. The price band is fixed at Rs 258-Rs 272 per share, with listing expected on BSE and NSE.

news.headline: Fortis Healthcare shares in focus as Supreme Court allows forensic audit to proceed
news.summary: Fortis Healthcare shares will be in focus after the Supreme Court allowed a forensic audit of the hospital chain to proceed, while clarifying that observations made by the Delhi High Court were limited to the audit proceedings. Fortis said no liability, penalty or fine has been imposed and reiterated that it had no role in the transfer of shares by its erstwhile promoters.

news.headline: Jefferies names Max Financial as its top insurance pick, sees 41% upside despite target cut
news.summary: Jefferies has moved Max Financial Services to the top of its life insurance picks, retaining a Buy rating despite cutting its target price. The brokerage expects regulatory changes to have a manageable impact on growth and sees further opportunities through Axis Bank.

news.headline: India’s potential IPO pipeline swells to Rs 3.86 lakh crore, 3.5 times funds raised so far in 2026: Report
news.summary: India’s potential mainboard IPO pipeline is estimated at around Rs 3.86 lakh crore in the second of 2026, nearly 3.5 times the Rs 1.10 lakh crore raised so far in the year, according to AIBI. Of this, potential IPOs worth Rs 2.43 lakh crore have received the Sebi approval, while another Rs 1.44 lakh crore is awaiting clearance, the report said.

news.headline: Tonbo Imaging India gets SEBI nod for IPO; defence electronics maker offers over 1.8 crore shares
news.summary: Tonbo Imaging has received SEBI approval for its proposed IPO, comprising an offer for sale of up to 18.09 million shares. The defence electronics maker has a global footprint, with more than 28,000 systems deployed across 24 countries.

news.headline: Global Market: BOJ policymakers see case for faster rate hikes as inflation risks mount
news.summary: Bank of Japan officials are actively acknowledging the pressing concerns regarding rising inflation. A faction within the bank advocates for a quicker adjustment in interest rates to align with their inflation target. They caution that a delay in these rate hikes could detrimentally affect the economy. Recent actions from the BOJ suggest a careful transition to tighter monetary policies, emphasizing ongoing vigilance in monitoring inflation trends.

news.headline: HDFC Bank CEO transition nears; Jefferies sees rerating scope, sets target at Rs 880
news.summary: HDFC Bank could be nearing a leadership transition, with Jefferies saying greater clarity on CEO succession and a management reshuffle could improve execution and support a rerating. The brokerage retained its Buy rating and Rs 880 target, citing scope for stronger deposit growth, fee income and a better loan mix.

news.headline: Global Market: European shares edge higher as British housebuilders rally
news.summary: European shares edged higher, with the STOXX 600 gaining 0.3%, led by a sharp rally in British housebuilders. Gains were capped by rising oil prices and elevated bond yields, as investors assessed inflation and interest-rate risks. Energy stocks advanced, while miners declined, with markets awaiting central-bank officials’ comments on monetary policy.

news.headline: Ace investor Madhu Kela owns 8.99% in Sunil Singhania-led Abakkus AMC’s holding company,  DRHP shows
news.summary: Ace investor Madhuri Madhusudan Kela holds an 8.99% share of the total capital contribution in Abakkus Expert Professionals LLP, the holding company and promoter of Abakkus Asset Manager. The Sunil Singhania-led asset manager has filed its DRHP with Sebi for an IPO comprising an offer for sale of 15 million shares.

news.headline: Rupee pinned just shy of 96/USD as RBI intervention counters oil woes
news.summary: The Indian rupee experienced a slight dip as surging oil prices emerged from stalled diplomacy between the US and Iran. With escalating tensions across the Middle East, Brent crude oil rose considerably. To counteract further declines, the Reserve Bank of India stepped in to ensure the rupee remained above the 96 per dollar threshold. Consequently, India's foreign exchange reserves fell, reflecting these currency stabilization efforts.

news.headline: IPO allotments today: How to check allotment status for Elevate Campuses, Swastika Infra & ArMee Infotech on NSE, BSE & registrars?
news.summary: IPO allotments for Elevate Campuses, Swastika Infra and ArMee Infotech are expected on September 28, following subscription between September 23 and 25. Investors can check status through NSE, BSE and respective registrars. The three companies are scheduled to list on September 30, with refunds expected by September 29 for unsuccessful applicants.

news.headline: Micron earnings preview: Tight DRAM supply, HBM demand set stage for Q4 results
news.summary: Micron’s Q4 results face high expectations as AI-driven memory demand, tight DRAM and HBM supply, and pricing power support growth. Investors will focus on fiscal 2027 guidance, HBM4 demand, margins, capital spending and whether the memory upcycle can sustain elevated valuations and profitability.

news.headline: PB Fintech among 4 F&O stocks with a sharp rise in futures open interest
news.summary: A notable increase in futures open interest indicates a substantial rise in the number of active, unexpired futures contracts in a security.
